schema_text:
PostgreSQL tables:
customers(id bigint PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL)
orders(id bigint PRIMARY KEY, customer_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), total_amount numeric(12,2) NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL, created_at timestamp NOT NULL)
Business rules: paid orders have status = 'paid'; total_amount is the order total, not a line-item value. created_at stores UTC timestamps.
question: 查询 2025 年 1 月已付款订单金额最高的前 10 位客户，返回客户 ID、姓名和总金额，按总金额降序，金额相同按客户 ID 升序。
